editorial_rules.confidence_bands: high = fair probability >= 0.60, market sample >= 8 tips, card price inside 1.40-101.00; medium = fair probability >= 0.50; low = everything else. Applied by tools/pricing.py, not by hand.
editorial_rules.cal2_note: Handball only: OLBG's handball listing prints 'Tie' as the most-popular pick for nearly every match, which makes the printed split unusable. For those matches we price from the competition base rate OLBG publishes for EHF Champions League men (favourites won 446 of 654, 68.2%), shrunk 15% toward 50% to allow for our ignorance of the specific match-up. Method tag CAL-2.
